title: Replace CDN links with GitHub Pages and modernize data dictionaries
description:
## Summary

The legacy `rsacdn.link` CDN is being retired. This repo now publishes via **GitHub Pages** (enabled on `main`, root). This PR repoints all data dictionary references to Pages URLs and modernizes the dictionary sources.

## Changes

- **Repoint data dictionary links (milestone files):** `illuminance` and `precip` dictionaries now link to `https://rstudio.github.io/academy-tidyverse-solar-power/assets/<name>_dictionary.html` instead of `rsacdn.link`.
- **Fix the old-prefix link in the report:** `assets/illuminance_report.qmd` (and its rendered `.html`) linked the illuminance dictionary via a different, older CDN path (`internal/solar-power/...`). Both are repointed to the Pages URL.
- **Modernize the dictionary sources:** `illuminance_dictionary` and `precip_dictionary` were plain Markdown fragments (`.md`, no YAML front matter). Converted to native Quarto `.qmd` (`format: html`, default **cosmo** theme, `embed-resources: true`), preserving git history via rename.
- **Re-rendered** both dictionary HTML files.

## Verification

- `grep` confirms **no** `rsacdn`, `cerulean`, or `teachthis` references remain in any `.qmd` or `.html` (this includes the previously-overlooked old-prefix URL inside the report).
- Both dictionaries re-rendered self-contained (no `_files/` sidecar).
- GitHub Pages enabled and building; live dictionary URLs return HTTP 200.

Note: the report keeps its existing `flatly` theme (a built-in Bootswatch theme, no CDN dependency); only its embedded dictionary link changed.
